// census-want: 1
// W02-08 Z4 probe: the stream wire site in a goroutine inside the attempt —
// it outlives the attempt's lease (Fremd-Review 1 F-6 of W02-07, for
// ChatRawStream).
package oai

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/backends"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/dispatch"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/llm"
)

func streamGoroutineInAttempt(ctx context.Context) {
	llm.WalkChain(ctx, nil, "chat", nil, nil, llm.WalkRules{}, func(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, timeout time.Duration) (dispatch.Usage, bool, error) {
		go llm.ChatRawStream(context.Background(), *b, nil, timeout, 0, nil)
		return dispatch.Usage{}, false, nil
	})
}
